audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Tahm Kench Level 3, First item and 2+ items while whys[5] and whys[6] in the same matchup say Vayne wins both item stages, and the packet chart disagrees on four rows.
audit.why: His lane power is a stack-dependent stun, not raw damage: Tongue Lash only stuns at three An Acquired Taste stacks, which is a Levels 4-5 problem once he can chain them. Percent-max-health true damage is exactly what a health-stacking, shield-banking champion cannot answer, so both item rows are Vayne's.
audit.corrected: Vayne, Vayne, Skill, Tahm Kench, Vayne, Vayne, Vayne — matched full/content pairs with ratings.
sources: kit: Tongue Lash / An Acquired Taste text

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] gave no reason the first item matters here, and level 6 was written as generic Final Hour boilerplate.
audit.why: Blade of the Ruined King plus Silver Bolts is percent-max-health true damage, which scales with the health he stacks and ignores Thick Skin's resistances. Final Hour's Tumble invisibility also breaks the An Acquired Taste chain, since the stacks expire five seconds after the last hit.
audit.corrected: First item is percent-health true damage into a health stacker; Final Hour's stealth breaks his stack chain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three lines call Tongue Lash 'short range' and treat it as a stun on demand. It reaches 900 units — further than Condemn's 550 and Silver Bolts' 750 — and only stuns when the target already has three An Acquired Taste stacks. Nothing recorded that Thick Skin banks the damage you deal into a shield.
audit.why: Riot's text: Tongue Lash 'applies a stack of An Acquired Taste... If the champion already has 3 stacks, they are stunned and the stacks are consumed.' Thick Skin stores a percentage of the damage he takes and converts it to a shield on cast — so chip trades fund his defence. Abyssal Dive is a 21s-at-rank-1 knockup dive, his repositioning tool rather than a chase tool.
audit.corrected: Break the stack chain and Tongue Lash is only a 900-range slow; do not chip into Thick Skin.
sources: kit: Tongue Lash 900 range and text
